# ImpulseLog

> ImpulseLog is an iPhone app that helps people pause impulse purchases, log resisted purchases and almost-buys, spot spending patterns, and build savings habits through wait timers, goals, streaks, and ADHD-friendly gamification.

ImpulseLog is a financial wellness and behavior-change tool. It is not a bank, budgeting service, financial adviser, or medical service.

- [ADHD spending tracker](https://www.impulselog.com/adhd-spending-tracker/): ADHD-friendly spending-awareness features.
- [Shopping wait timer](https://www.impulselog.com/shopping-wait-timer/): Purchase pause and wait-timer workflow.
- [Founder story](https://www.impulselog.com/founder-story/): Why ImpulseLog was created.
